title: Allies and peoples who resisted: Tlaxcala, the Mapuche and the Chichimecas
goal: Read why Cortés had indigenous allies and why some peoples resisted for decades, and use the gerund to say how or why people acted.
grammar: The gerund for actions at the same time

items: Use the gerund to say how or why someone acted.
Say who Malintzin was and how she helped Cortés.
Explain why, according to many historians, the Mapuche were hard to conquer.
Say who defeated Pedro de Valdivia in 1553.
Say what the Spaniards did at the end of the Chichimeca War, according to historians.
I can use the gerund to say how or why someone acted.
